items.question: The study of population is called?

Which of these is a renewable source of energy?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms population density and population distribution. (2 marks)
2. State three factors that influence population distribution in Kenya. (3 marks)
3. Name three renewable sources of energy. (3 marks)
4. Using the diagram, identify the type of rainfall shown and explain how it forms. (4 marks)
5. State two problems facing urban centres in Kenya. (2 marks)
